en: Colorized vintage view of a formal stone staircase in a city park, flanked by manicured hedges and trees. Two broad stairways rise symmetrically on each side with a central decorative stone wall and balustrade above. In the foreground there is a circular flower bed enclosed by a low wrought‑iron fence. At the top center of the image, red printed text identifies the location in German.
